behavioralConstraints: checkRecoveryState uses read-only sources and returns frozen findings/runs sorted by stable task/path/code/message and key/run ordering; consistent is findings.length === 0 within local scan scope only

checker reports representative malformed, missing, mismatched, unregistered, stale, interrupted and incomplete state/evidence/journal/audit conditions without running validators, providers, repair, Git fetch or remote queries; future review stages are not falsely required as already-passed gates

apply requires registered task, exact current canonical branch revision (40 or 64 lowercase hex), exact target SHA-256, actor, reason, unique operation ID, and confirmedQuiescent true; unexpected request fields fail closed
operationId is 1..80 ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen characters starting alphanumeric; request timestamps for replacement expiry and recovery clock use canonical UTC millisecond form

recovery is offline: caller stops and independently verifies all runners, direct gates, external providers and repair processes; mutex excludes only other recovery calls and does not establish normal-writer exclusion or liveness

assignment release/transfer targets a valid schema 1.1.0 ACTIVE record on the canonical branch; expired assignments are recoverable explicitly, while active non-stale assignments require an override reference and separate trusted-host authorization

override authorization defaults to deny; request authorizationRef is audit context only, never proof of authority; CLI host policy uses IPT_RECOVERY_ADMIN_ACTORS and is an OS/operator boundary rather than authentication
transfer requires a different replacement lock ID and trimmed owner/run identity; optional expiry must be strictly after recovery time; task and canonical branch are preserved

release-run-lock requires original valid task-bound journal idempotencyKey, exact orchestration token hash and externally confirmed quiescence; journal owner/run/time are retained rather than invented or rebound

reset-task requires separately authorized override and uses existing legal lifecycle transitions through BLOCKED to REWORK_REQUIRED; existing BLOCKED skips the first step, existing REWORK_REQUIRED uses BOOT-021 resume, and illegal source transitions fail
reset or assignment repair refuses a retained orchestration lock or known merge-in-progress/completion facts; controlled-merge reconciliation remains BOOT-025 authority

intent is exclusively created and flushed before mutation; separate result is exclusively created after target verification, with hashes binding full prior/resulting bytes, request, actor, reason, timestamp, revision, branch and contextual identities

retry under the same operation ID requires the same semantic request; transport key order and explicit retained-mutex hash do not change operation identity; unfinished replay accepts only exact prior or planned resulting target bytes
completed retries require matching canonical expectedRevision, then validate and return stored historical APPLIED despite later target changes; no current readiness claim or audit overwrite

retained recovery mutex can be resumed only by its original operation with matching canonical requestHash, expectedRecoveryLockHash and renewed quiescence; works before primary intent and after result, appending immutable RELEASE_INTENT with full prior token before unlink; no age/PID stealing
full prior assignment bytes are retained in recovery audit rather than added to AssignmentLockStore.getAudit; consumers must combine both audit sources

normal BOOT-028 resume preserves original key/owner/run and durable attempts; new judgment after reset uses new run/key and matching assignment runId ${newOrchestrationRunId}::developer-start, with old journals/results/evidence retained
replacement owner/run cannot already own another registered task ACTIVE assignment; ambiguous Developer-start identity is rejected
apply state-tree inspection requires depth below 32 and fewer than 100000 visited entries; oversized or unsupported non-file trees fail closed
invariants: no repair approves validation/review, manufactures PASS evidence, reaches MERGED/DONE, or bypasses exact-head controlled merge
lifecycle history and historical evidence/journals/attempts are preserved; recovery metadata cannot replace authoritative gate evidence
branch refs and source work are never deleted, force-moved or reset by recovery; missing or changed canonical revision blocks apply
unsafe paths, unsupported/corrupt state and conflicting identities fail closed rather than becoming arbitrary JSON repair
quiescence is an operator precondition and cannot be inferred from observation, expiry, age or PID
examples: expired ACTIVE assignment transfers to a fresh matching owner/run lock while lifecycle and historical evidence remain unchanged
active non-stale release without trusted-host authorization raises OVERRIDE_DENIED even with a request authorizationRef
interrupted QA resumes via original BOOT-028 key/owner/run and exact payload after explicitly audited abandoned-token release
authorized reset records original/resulting lifecycle bytes and legal REWORK_REQUIRED history; BOOT-021 then owns resuming development
crash after target write before result resumes the same intent and completes its audit only if target matches planned bytes
edgeCases: empty local state can have no findings without saying GitHub bootstrap is complete
retained orchestration token/pending journal is a finding even for a live run, not proof of abandonment
unknown task, missing lifecycle/branch, stale target hash, symlink or malformed audit prevents mutation
pre-intent mutex recovery requires original requestHash; an unbound/malformed token requires forensic recovery and cannot be stolen by a new operation
old PASS at the same revision may still be CURRENT evidence after reset, but cannot substitute for the reset lifecycle or authorize a merge

forbiddenDependencies: arbitrary lifecycle destinations or evidence fabrication

expectations: keep check strictly observational and apply explicit/offline
preserve denied override, state conflict and audit failure as nonzero errors
never render APPLIED or consistent as passed workflow gates
acceptedRanges: RecoveryCheckReport consistent true or false with local findings/runs
RecoveryResult status APPLIED and typed recovery failures

expectations: inspect full prior/resulting state, reason, actor, timestamp/revision and immutable outcome
combine recovery and original assignment audit history
preserve normal resume identity and use a fresh identity only for genuinely new work after legal rework
acceptedRanges: immutable intent with or without completed result
typed refusal requiring investigation rather than automatic repair
requiredReachableRanges: complete emergency override audit without overwriting older evidence
